title: Leading Transformation

modules.title: Introduction and overview
modules.description: The five worlds, outcomes, Seven Ways to Save and Improve, and a hundred-day plan.

modules.title: Transformation and the possibilities of organisations
modules.description: Purpose, hierarchy, distributed leadership, accountability, and the possibilities of organisational life.

modules.title: System leadership: purpose and measures
modules.description: Shared purpose, technical and adaptive challenges, viable systems, and measures that inform action.

modules.title: Leading in complexity: the uses of power
modules.description: Power, commitment, contracting, action inquiry, and leading change without complete control.

modules.title: People in systems
modules.description: Relationships, adult development, resilience, and support for the change practitioner.

modules.title: The limits of methods
modules.description: Consulting judgement, assumptions, context, and learning by trying ideas in the real world.

modules.title: Mapping systems
modules.description: Rich pictures, soft systems, system dynamics, archetypes, and the uses and limits of diagrams.

modules.title: Understanding organisations
modules.description: Service views, organisational maturity, business models, and the Viable System Model.

modules.title: Designing organisations
modules.description: Service architecture, operating models, delegation, roles, tasks, and decision authority.

modules.title: Shaping culture
modules.description: Understanding culture and working on the conditions that reproduce it.

modules.title: Citizen and customer insight
modules.description: Purpose, needs, co-design, journey mapping, listening, focus groups, and customer safaris.

modules.title: Behavioural insight and strengths-based approaches
modules.description: Behaviour, community assets, strengths, and Positive Deviance.

modules.title: Understanding demand
modules.description: Demand analysis, provision and supply, and the fit between a need and a service channel.

modules.title: Understanding and designing services
modules.description: Seven Ways to Save and Improve, activity and process analysis, Resource Optimisation, and service design.

modules.title: Cost analysis and building the business case
modules.description: Activity-based costing, options, and a business case that connects resources to the work.

modules.title: A deep dive into lean
modules.description: Purpose, flow, respect for people, A3 thinking, waste, inquiry, and the risks of applying tools mechanically.

modules.title: Prototyping
modules.description: Principles and practical approaches for testing service changes through rapid prototypes.

modules.title: Delivering change
modules.description: Readiness, appreciative timelines, Breaking the Shell, project and risk management, and learning loops.

modules.title: Communications and stakeholder management
modules.description: Listening, vision, objections, stakeholder mapping, and working in a political setting.

modules.group: Change and learning: sustaining the work
modules.title: Understanding people
modules.description: Responses to threat and reward, and practical ways of engaging people through change.

modules.group: Change and learning: sustaining the work
modules.title: Managing change positively
modules.description: Appreciative Inquiry, action learning, force-field analysis, and constructive conversations.

modules.group: Change and learning: sustaining the work
modules.title: Embedding change
modules.description: Ownership, process management, benefits, outcomes, and the distinction between targets and useful measures.

modules.group: Change and learning: sustaining the work
modules.title: Strategy and change
modules.description: Learning, Patterns of Strategy, scenarios, whole-system processes, commissioning, and delivery arrangements.

modules.title: Recap and summary
modules.description: Review the repertoire, its application, and what the participant will take forward. An immersive simulation can be added to a blended programme.

typical_duration: 24 modules, commonly two per month over twelve months

tool_shed.sessions: Typically two 90-minute online co-coaching sessions each month
support: Facilitated peer learning and action learning
Direct mentoring and shadow consulting by agreement
